title: Understanding Silhouette Scores
text: A silhouette score measures how similar a point is to its own cluster compared to other clusters. A negative score indicates that a point might be closer to a neighboring cluster than to its own cluster.

title: Analyzing Clustering B
text: Look at the distances between points within the same cluster and compare them to the distances to points in other clusters. Are there any points that seem closer to a different cluster?

title: Evaluating Cluster Separation
text: In Clustering B, do any points appear to be closer to a different cluster than their own?
